title: VMC 84 947 Sugarcane (NSIC Sc 8): Yield, Maturity and Characteristics
metaTitle: VMC 84 947 Sugarcane: Yield, Maturity and Characteristics
metaDescription: VMC 84 947 sugarcane is a sugarcane variety. See its days to harvest, yield, pest ratings, traits and where it grows best.
excerpt: VMC 84 947 is a registered sugarcane variety, also sold or known as NSIC Sc 8. It was registered with the National Seed Industry Council in 2002 as NSIC 2002 Sc 8. Vict. Expt. Station bred it. It takes about 10.5 months from planting to harvest, with 173 LKg of sugar per hectare on average in the trials.

blocks.text: If you came here looking for NSIC Sc 8, this is the same sugarcane. Its seller and farm sources add notes, listed at the end. Compare it with the others in our [sugarcane variety finder](/crop-varieties/sugarcane), or see [every crop variety](/crop-varieties) we list. For the crop itself, read our guide: [Land preparation for sugarcane](/land-preparation/sugarcane-land-preparation).

**Yield:** 173 LKg of sugar per hectare on average in the trials.

blocks.text: How long does it take, and how much does it yield?

VMC 84 947 sugarcane takes about 10.5 months from planting to harvest. That is about the average of the 16 sugarcane varieties with a day count, 10.8 months. Count the months from planting, and plan the harvest for a dry stretch when you can.

Its average yield of 173 LKg/ha beats the average of its group, 160.71. Sugar yield is counted in LKg, bags of 50 kilograms of raw sugar per hectare. Trial yields come from well managed plots, so your own will depend on water, fertilizer, pests and timing.

Once you know the day count, anee.io dates every task from each lot's own planting day, with [the growth stages and weather](/features/growth-stages-and-weather) beside it.
Is it resistant to pests and diseases?

blocks.caption: Reactions in trials, rated under natural field conditions
rows: Took a middling share of damage
Took some damage but held up

blocks.text: It showed no weak spot in the ratings on record. Still, a resistant variety can break down when a new strain or pest population comes, so keep scouting. Read up on [Corn downy mildew](/diseases/corn-downy-mildew), [Rice field rats](/pests/rice-field-rats).

The pests and diseases that hit sugarcane fields most often: [Rice field rats](/pests/rice-field-rats), [Corn downy mildew](/diseases/corn-downy-mildew), [white grub](/pests/white-grub). Our [pest finder](/pests) and [disease finder](/diseases) help you name what you see.
Its stalks grew about 231 cm long and 2.52 cm thick. The fiber content is 13 to 14 percent. Trash: self trashing, which decides how much cleaning the cane needs before milling.
What its seller and farm sources say

items: **Harvest:** Matures in 10 to 11 months, best cut January to April.
**Fruit:** Stalks about 231 cm, 2.52 cm thick, fiber 13 to 14 percent.
About 9 tillers per hill, self trashing.
Resistant to downy mildew, leaf scorch and smut, moderately resistant to rust.

blocks.text: Why farmers know it: a commercial cane known for heavy tillering and for holding up on eroded, drought prone fields, parent of PSR 00 343. Check these against what farmers near you have seen, because the same variety can do differently from one town to the next.
Where and when to plant VMC 84 947 sugarcane

Mills pay for sugar, not cane, so compare the sugar yield in LKg per hectare as well as the tonnes of cane. Pick a variety that ratoons well, and one rated against smut and downy mildew, the diseases that cut a ratoon crop short. Before planting, get the field ready with our guide: [Land preparation in the Philippines](/land-preparation/land-preparation-philippines).

items.q: Is NSIC Sc 8 the same as VMC 84 947?
items.a: Yes. NSIC Sc 8 is another name for VMC 84 947, registered as NSIC 2002 Sc 8. Seed sellers use both, so ask for either one.

items.q: How long does it take to harvest?
items.a: It takes about 10.5 months from planting to harvest. Then the weather and your care decide the exact day.
The record shows 173 LKg of sugar per hectare on average in the trials. Your own yield depends on the soil, water, fertilizer and pests on your farm.

items.q: Where can I buy seed of VMC 84 947?
items.a: Ask an accredited seed dealer in your province, the seller named on this page or your municipal agriculturist. Look for the certified seed tag or a sealed pack before you pay.
